title: selliguea tenuipes
intro: Selliguea tenuipes, commonly known as Chinese polypodium, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea tenuipes include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
